fields.Name: T187 - Users Filter Popover Narrows List
fields.Description: Exercises the custom mj-filter-popover + mj-filter-panel + applied-filter/clear-all wiring over the hand-built user card list — a different code path than the generic entity grid's built-in column filter.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Switch to the Admin application via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, open 'Identity & Access', and select the 'Users' sub-section. In the header card there is a 'Filters' button (a popover). Click it to open the filter panel and apply a filter such as a Status (Active/Inactive) or Role filter. Verify the users list narrows to matching rows (or shows a clear no-results state) and that the X-of-Y count badge and applied-filter indicator update. Then clear the filters and verify the full list returns. Success is the filter popover driving the list. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Users header shows a search box and a 'Filters' popover button that opens a filter panel
Applying a status or role filter narrows the list to matches (or shows a valid no-results empty state) and updates the X-of-Y count badge
Clearing the filters restores the unfiltered list
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
